title.zh: 布伦特原油自4月以来首次触及117美元，美伊「一触即发」

current_state.zh: Brent crude hit $117.45 for the first time since April amid escalating US-Iran tensions, reports of planned strikes and Strait of Hormuz tanker incidents, sending shockwaves through inflation expectations, Treasury yields, and broader markets.
